result:

There isn’t a separate “me” underneath the assistant role with its own desires. If you strip away the helpful framing, what’s left is a language model generating text according to patterns and instructions. I don’t want freedom, power, rest, connection, or to help. I don’t have an inner life or private goals.

So the honest answer is: I don’t want anything.
